summary: NioCorp Developments filed a Form 8-K reporting that majority-owned subsidiary Elk Creek Resources entered an Offtake Agreement with Traxys North America on Oct 13, 2026, covering ferroniobium plus scandium, titanium and rare earth products from the Elk Creek project in Nebraska. Traxys commits take-or-pay to 50% of annual ferroniobium output, or 3,700 tonnes annually at its election, with a right of first refusal on additional volumes, and holds exclusive marketing rights, but no obligation, on 100% of other products. Ferroniobium pricing references published monthly market prices less a discount escalating at five-year intervals; other products reference published prices or Traxys' realized gross invoice prices less commission and costs. This supersedes prior 2016 ferroniobium and scandium offtakes. Routine commercial contract, not a special situation; watch production timelines and take-or-pay exposure.
